ratings_why.fun: Every buy and sell is a seat-count call, growth is smooth and linear from the Kit to Levy-Master, and Miller plus Kobus gives a real chase; Attack growth is thin late.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7: one shared Health for the whole tribe, where buying a unit lowers everyone and selling raises them, plays unlike any tribe today or any generic buff tribe.

verdict_why: The seated-Bird loop compounds as written and the Spaarndam Pup's split needs an order with Shield and the damage keywords; the rest can settle.

points.text: A Bird seated by Heemraad comes home with doubled Level-sized Health and pours it back, so the Level grows by a share of itself every two turns: a compounding loop. Make Fly South on a Board unit double only its printed Health.
The Spaarndam Pup's split doesn't say how it meets Shield, Hunker, Damage Reduction, Nightshade or Cleave. Say whether the hit is reduced before or after it is split.

Health climbs well but Attack only gets +1 a turn from Winter Raft and Dike-Walker. A Tier 5 or 6 card that turns the Level into Attack, like a bigger Rearing Coot, would let tall boards finish fights late.
Old Bram Stuw should say which Level he reads in a fight: the one at Start of Combat, or Hendrika's raised one.
Any Board unit bought and sold leaves its Health behind, so buying for water is a steady play from turn 1. Worth leaning into with one early card that rewards it, beyond Ledger Coot.

standouts.why: A Tier 2 that scales with the whole Pool, so it stays useful into the late game.
Makes every slot a choice between paying the levy and sitting on the Board; a clear direction card.
The drowning the seed promises, and it bites your own outsiders too, so seats matter.

weakest.why: A 1/1 Chick a turn mostly dilutes the Level; it lives only through Ledger Coot and Old Bram.
Only about 5 net stats a turn at Tier 4, and its Level 6 gate is easy to miss in the wide build where it is meant to go.
1 gold a turn on a 1/4 body is a thin Tier 2 unless you are already selling Chicks.

flags.note: Seated Bird plus Fly South compounds the Level every two turns, with no cap.
Kobus with the Miller and Levy-Master pours about 80 a turn at Tier 5, and far more with goldens. Linear, but the high roll to watch.
With Hendrika's raise it can wipe a wide enemy board at Start of Combat before a single attack.
Order of the split against Shield, Hunker, Damage Reduction and Nightshade isn't stated.
2 gold a turn at Tier 4, 4 golden, fed cheaply by Biesbosch Kits and the Miller.
